title: VaultSync — Guild Data Pipeline
subtitle: Unified architecture for auction price sync, guild bank export, and website integration
description: Complete design specification for VaultSync: the guild's automated data pipeline connecting TurtleWoW game client data to the tbcguild.duckdns.org website. VaultSync is the umbrella name for two production subsystems — GuildShopSync (auction house price scanning + upload) and GBankExport (guild bank inventory scanning + local export) — plus the server-side API and website components that consume their data. This document covers existing working artifacts, their architecture, data flow, and a phased plan for future enhancements including server-side guild bank API integration.

projectOverview.primaryGoal: Automate the flow of game data (AH prices, guild bank contents) from client to website with zero manual steps after initial install
projectOverview.techStack: TurtleWoW 1.12.1 Lua addons | .NET WinForms C# tray app | PowerShell file watcher | Deno Fresh API | Inno Setup installer
projectOverview.status: GuildShopSync v3.1 — PRODUCTION | GBankExport v3.0 — LOCAL EXPORT WORKING

routes.purpose: TurtleWoW addon — scans 68 consume items at the Auction House. Queries each item by name via QueryAuctionItems(), processes AUCTION_ITEM_LIST_UPDATE events, stores lowest buyout-per-unit in SavedVariables as GuildShopSyncDB.prices. Sets triggerUpload=true flag when scan completes. Shows 'Sync Prices' button on AH frame. Popup prompts ReloadUI to flush SavedVariables to disk.
routes.access: /gss scan | /gss debug | /gss stop | 'Sync Prices' button on AH

routes.purpose: Compiled .NET WinForms system tray application. Polls WTF/Account/**/GuildShopSync.lua every 3 seconds for triggerUpload=true. Parses Lua table via regex, builds JSON payload, HTTP PUTs to API. Clears trigger flag on success. Named mutex (Global\GuildShopSyncTray) prevents duplicates. Registry Run key for auto-start. SessionEnding handler for clean shutdown. Balloon notifications on upload. Context menu with status, log folder, exit.
routes.access: System tray icon — auto-starts at login via HKCU\...\Run

routes.purpose: Inno Setup 6 installer script. Detects TurtleWoW path (registry, env var, common paths). Copies EXE to Program Files, addon to WoW/Interface/AddOns. Sets Registry Run key for auto-start. Cleans up all previous versions (PowerShell scripts, Task Scheduler tasks, env vars, VBS startup scripts). Handles upgrade from v2.x/v3.0 gracefully.

TurtleWoW addon — hooks GuildBankFrame OnShow/OnHide. Auto-scans all unlocked tabs when bank opens. Reads GuildBankFrameItem{1-98} button properties (.occupied, .itemID, .count, .tab). Resolves names via GetItemInfo(). Builds per-tab item lists + cross-tab summary. Exports both structured (GBankExport_Data) and flat pipe-delimited (GBankExport_FlatData) to SavedVariables.
routes.access: /gbe scan | /gbe status | /gbe list | /gbe tabs | /gbe debug | auto-scan on bank open

routes.purpose: PowerShell background watcher. Polls WTF/Account/**/SavedVariables/GBankExport.lua every 5 seconds. Parses GBankExport_FlatData (GBANKEXPORT_V1 pipe-delimited format). Exports to GuildBank_{Account}.json and GuildBank_{Account}.txt. Named mutex prevents duplicates. Log rotation at 2MB. Debounce wait (1.5s) after detecting changes to let WoW finish writing.
routes.access: Background process — started manually or via Windows Startup

routes.purpose: Deno Fresh API endpoint. Receives JSON price payload from GuildShopSyncTray.exe. Stores prices in Deno KV under ['consumes','prices']. Returns {success:true} on valid write. Website reads these prices to display current AH market values on the /consumes shop page.
routes.access: HTTPS PUT from tray app only

uiDesignDecisions.rationale: PowerShell dies on logoff (STATUS_CONTROL_C_EXIT 0xC000013A) because it's a console subsystem process. WinForms apps are GUI subsystem — handle WM_QUERYENDSESSION gracefully via SystemEvents.SessionEnding.

uiDesignDecisions.optionsPresented: Task Scheduler vs Registry Run Key
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: Task Scheduler had issues: wouldn't restart after sleep, required password re-entry after updates. Registry Run is the standard method for per-user tray apps.
Kernel-level mutex auto-releases on crash. PID files go stale. Global prefix works across RDP + console sessions.
FileSystemWatcher misses events with WoW's atomic rename-into-place write pattern. Polling is simple, reliable, negligible CPU.

uiDesignDecisions.optionsPresented: Parse Lua Tables vs Flat Pipe-Delimited
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: TurtleWoW Lua 5.0 has no JSON library. Flat format is trivial to parse externally: split by newline, split by pipe, switch on tag.

uiDesignDecisions.optionsPresented: C-side API vs UI Frame Properties
uiDesignDecisions.rationale: TurtleWoW's guild bank is 100% custom Lua with no C-side API. Frame property reading (.occupied, .itemID, .count, .tab) is the only approach.
